answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade. A newcomer starts with a violet-tier trust score that only rises after a history of honest attestations, so a flood of fresh identities cannot outvote established ones. If an agent is caught attesting false work, its bond is slashed and its reputation delta turns negative, wiping months of earned standing. An attacker facing a rising tide of honest agents must therefore fund thousands of bonds and lose them all on detection, while honest agents risk nothing. The cost scales with the attack, not with the defense.
